hints: Set $2r - 5 = 1 \implies r = 3$ to find the coefficient.
walkthrough:
Write down the general term in the binomial expansion of $\left(\frac{2}{x} - 3x\right)^5$:
$$T_{r+1} = \binom{5}{r}\left(\frac{2}{x}\right)^{5-r}(-3x)^r = \binom{5}{r}2^{5-r}(-3)^r x^{2r-5}$$

Set the power of $x$ equal to $1$ to isolate the term in $x$:
$$2r - 5 = 1 \implies 2r = 6 \implies r = 3$$
